Change c0341. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. I; 1831 Ch. XVIII.

Context before (unchanged): If you feel thus, we shall assuredly be happy, however present events may cast a gloom over us.

1818 text: But it is this gloom, which appears to have taken so strong a hold of your mind, that I wish to dissipate. Tell me, therefore, whether you object to an immediate solemnization of the marriage.

1831 text: But it is this gloom which appears to have taken so strong a hold of your mind, that I wish to dissipate. Tell me, therefore, whether you object to an immediate solemnisation of the marriage.

Diff: But it is this gloom [-,-] which appears to have taken so strong a hold of your mind, that I wish to dissipate. Tell me, therefore, whether you object to an immediate [-solemnization-] {+solemnisation+} of the marriage.

Context after (unchanged): We have been unfortunate, and recent events have drawn us from that every-day tranquillity befitting my years and infirmities.

result.rationale: The substantive change is z-to-s orthography in 'solemnization' becoming 'solemnisation'; the comma removal after 'gloom' is punctuation only. No wording or meaning changes.
